title: Review artifacts in isolated reviewer context
narrative: Independent review must not reuse the producer's accumulated reasoning by default. Reviewers see the artifact and acceptance contract; disagreement is retained. Accepts inspiration requirement 10[^insp-r10]. Recipe-contract coverage for personal-agent MH-PA-03; produce-critique-refine delta: `fangore_insp_produce_critique_refine`[^insp-pa-03-review].
implementation: Agentic Recipe `independent_review` (`IndependentReviewTemplate`) builds produce → isolated review_* → aggregate_reviews with omit_producer_reasoning and retain_disagreement.
validation: Harness `graph_recipes` op `independent_review_template`. Soft expects isolated payload flags and two reviewers.
